objective: Implement deterministic 24/7 Continuous Demo Learning loop operations with ordered stage evidence, cadence, checkpoint/resume, stale-data/backpressure and safe-hold controls while allowing automated controlled retraining but never automated live promotion.
scope: Define deterministic permanent learning-loop stage order from observe/analyze through promotion governance
Require content-addressed evidence for each completed stage
Enforce prefix ordering so later stages cannot skip earlier stages
Implement deterministic cadence and next-due checkpoint
Fail closed on stale market watermark, unhealthy system state or excessive consecutive failures
Allow automated Controlled Retraining action only inside P18-E boundary
Route promotion step only to P18-H governance evaluation
out_of_scope: Production scheduler infrastructure outside the deterministic loop contract
tests: Stage ordering deterministic and skip attempts fail closed
Automated retraining allowed but automated live promotion false
rollback: Revert P18-I loop/config/tests/evidence/CI/state; P18-H remains canonical and P19 remains unstarted.
